Restyle this app so it looks like the rest of Repro Suite (see https://paperrepro-aiid.atoms.world/repro/index.html). Change only the look and the navigation; keep every feature, text, table and the EN / 中文 switch working as now.

DESIGN SYSTEM
- Light theme first, dark on a toggle button (☾ / ☀), remembered in localStorage key "repro.theme2".
- Light: background #FBFBFD, cards #FFFFFF, soft fill #F3F3F6, text #1D1D1F, secondary text #5C5C66, borders #E4E4EA, accent #2B59FF, accent tint #ECF0FF, success #15803D, warning #B45309, error #C62828. Dark: background #0B0B0E, cards #151519, soft #1C1C22, text #F4F4F6, secondary #ADADB8, borders #2A2A31, accent #7B96FF, accent tint #1B2146.
- Font Inter (Google Fonts) with Noto Sans SC for Chinese; JetBrains Mono for numbers, ids and code. Headlines weight 800, letter-spacing -0.035em. Cards radius 16px, 1px border, soft shadow 0 8px 24px rgba(16,24,40,.06). Pill buttons (radius 999px), primary = accent. Generous white space. One accent colour only; no serif fonts.

LAYOUT: left sidebar 248px (sticky, full height; under 900px a drawer opened from a ☰ button in a slim top bar). Top of the sidebar: black rounded square logo with a white letter "I", the app name "IndexBoard", grey line "part of Repro Suite". First group "IndexBoard": the app's own pages or sections (use the pages and sections it already has). Then group "Repro Suite" (new tab, small ↗): Paper Explainer https://paperexplainer-aiid.pub.atoms.world , Paper Repro Agent https://paperrepro-aiid.atoms.world/repro/index.html , Benchmark https://paperrepro-aiid.atoms.world/repro/bench.html , All apps https://reprosuite-aiid.atoms.world . Bottom: theme and language buttons. Remove the old top navigation bar.
Check both themes and that 390px wide has no horizontal scroll.
I'll look at the shared button, tabs and font usages before restyling.
I'll apply the Repro Suite theme to the global styles, theme state and chart colours, and replace the old top bar with a sidebar layout.
I'll run a mechanical rename of the old font classes across files and confirm what remains.
I'll switch every page to the new sidebar shell, make buttons and tabs pill-shaped, sync the sidebar with the editor tabs, and add the new English and Chinese navigation text.
Pages are on the new sidebar shell; next I'll run lint and the production build.
Lint and build pass, so I'll check the new shell in light mode.

IndexBoard now uses the Repro Suite look and navigation. Every feature, text, table and the EN / 中文 switch still works. Lint and the production build pass, and a visual check of the home page in light mode passed.

I haven't checked the dark theme or the 390px-wide layout on screen yet, so please look at both in the App Viewer before publishing. The pages are built to wrap or scroll inside their own boxes, but that isn't the same as checking.

**Look**
- **Colours:** light theme by default, using your exact light and dark palette, with #2B59FF as the only accent colour.
- **Fonts:** Inter, with Noto Sans SC for Chinese. Headlines are weight 800 with tight letter spacing, and there are no serif fonts left.
- **Numbers, codes and keys:** shown in JetBrains Mono, both on the page and on the chart axes and values.
- **Shapes:** 16px cards with a 1px border and soft shadow. Buttons and tabs are pill-shaped, and primary buttons use the accent colour.
- **Charts:** recoloured to match, and they switch with the theme.
- **Print view and PNG copies:** these stay light so they print and paste cleanly.

**Navigation**
- The old top bar is gone. There's a sticky 248px left sidebar with:
  - **Logo:** a black rounded square with a white "I", "IndexBoard", and the grey line "part of Repro Suite".
  - **IndexBoard group:** Home, Featured boards, Recent boards, New board, Describe it, Templates. The current page is highlighted. The last two open the matching tab on the create page.
  - **Repro Suite group:** Paper Explainer, Paper Repro Agent, Benchmark and All apps. Each opens in a new tab and has a small ↗.
  - **Bottom:** a ☾ / ☀ theme button and the EN / 中文 switch.
- **Below 900px wide:** the sidebar becomes a drawer, opened from a ☰ button in a slim top bar. It closes when you tap outside it, press Escape, or pick a link.

**Things that behave differently**
- **Theme memory:** the theme is saved in the browser under "repro.theme2". It starts light, so it no longer follows the system's dark mode.
- **Chinese link names:** in 中文 the suite links show translated names (论文讲解, 论文复现助手, 基准评测, 全部应用). Tell me if you'd rather keep the English names in both languages.

You can try it in the App Viewer, then click Publish to deploy.

# Project Summary
IndexBoard helps AI researchers, students, and teams turn model, tool, or method evaluations into shareable leaderboards. Authors can enter scores and uncertainty intervals, describe their methodology, and publish a read-only board while keeping a private edit key. Boards can be created in the editor, from templates, or from a written description using AI.

For AI model comparisons, IndexBoard can retrieve real model data from Artificial Analysis or OpenRouter, show its source and attribution, and refresh results. Other AI-generated boards retain the existing draft workflow, with placeholder values flagged for review. The home page highlights a pinned board and recent publications. The app also supports charts, printing, JSON exports, English and Chinese, and light and dark themes. Boards are stored in Atoms Cloud.

# Project Module Description
- **Board authoring:** Create and edit board details, methodology, metrics, and results. Enter data in a table, paste JSON or CSV, use a template, or generate a draft from a description.
- **AI creation:** For model comparisons, AI identifies requested models and metrics before fetching available real data. Unsupported metrics are omitted with a note. Other descriptions use the draft workflow with placeholder warnings.
- **Live model data:** A backend endpoint accepts model names or a “top N” request. Artificial Analysis is preferred when `AA_API_KEY` is configured; OpenRouter is used otherwise and as a fallback. Model lists are cached for six hours. If a source is unavailable, the last cached data may be returned as stale.
- **Model matching and rankings:** Loose model-name matching selects current flagship models and excludes small, batch, and alias variants. Without Artificial Analysis, “top N” returns newest flagship models, not models ranked by evaluation scores.
- **Board viewing and refresh:** Live-data boards show source attribution and fetch time. Refresh uses the same model selection; board owners can save refreshed data, while other visitors see updates only in their own view.
- **Discovery:** The home page features a pinned board and lists recent published boards.
- **Analysis and sharing:** View charts, interval whiskers, score-versus-cost comparisons, rankings, and methodology. Public links are read-only; editing requires the private key.
- **Export and display:** Print boards, copy or download charts, and download or re-import board JSON. Supports English and Chinese, plus light and dark themes.
- **Supporting services:** Backend modules provide authentication, database access, storage, settings, health checks, and AI integrations.

# Directory Tree
```text
.
├── DESIGN.md                              # Product design and architecture notes
└── app/
    ├── start_app_v2.sh                    # Application startup helper
    ├── backend/
    │   ├── core/                          # Configuration, auth, database, telemetry
    │   ├── dependencies/                  # Shared API dependencies
    │   ├── models/                        # Database models, including model-data cache
    │   ├── routers/                       # HTTP API endpoints, including board and model data
    │   ├── schemas/                       # API request and response contracts
    │   ├── services/                      # Board, model-data, cache, and supporting logic
    │   ├── data_models/                   # Board definitions and model-data cache JSON
    │   ├── alembic/                       # Database migrations
    │   ├── skills_docs/                   # Atoms Cloud integration guides
    │   ├── main.py                        # Backend application entry point
    │   └── lambda_handler.py              # Serverless handler
    └── frontend/
        ├── src/
        │   ├── pages/                     # Home, editor, board, print, and blog pages
        │   ├── components/                # Board, live-data, blog, and shared UI
        │   └── lib/                       # API clients, board logic, AI, live data, i18n
        ├── prerender/                     # Blog prerendering and sitemap utilities
        ├── plugins/                       # Development safeguards and tests
        ├── public/                        # Static assets and crawler directives
        ├── package.json                   # Frontend dependencies and scripts
        └── vite.config.ts                 # Vite configuration
```

# File Description Inventory
- `DESIGN.md` — Product design and implementation notes.
- `app/backend/main.py` — Configures and launches the API application.
- `app/backend/routers/indexboard.py` — Board API endpoints, including public board listing.
- `app/backend/routers/model_data.py` — Endpoint for retrieving cleaned model data.
- `app/backend/services/model_data.py` — Fetches and normalizes external model data.
- `app/backend/services/model_data_cache.py` — Caches source data and supports stale-cache fallback.
- `app/backend/models/model_data_cache.py` — Database model for cached model data.
- `app/backend/data_models/model_data_cache.json` — Model-data cache definition or seed data.
- `app/backend/alembic/versions/e8cd3352e30c_auto_update.py` — Migration for the model-data cache.
- `app/backend/routers/`, `services/`, `models/`, and `schemas/` — Remaining API endpoints, business logic, database entities, and data contracts.
- `app/backend/core/` — Configuration, authentication, database setup, encryption, environment handling, and telemetry.
- `app/backend/skills_docs/` — Integration guidance for AI, custom APIs, object storage, and the web SDK.
- `app/frontend/src/pages/Index.tsx` — Home page with featured and recent boards.
- `app/frontend/src/pages/EditorPage.tsx` — Board editor, templates, and AI creation flow.
- `app/frontend/src/pages/BoardPage.tsx` — Board display and live-data refresh.
- `app/frontend/src/pages/PrintPage.tsx` — Print layout, including live-data attribution.
- `app/frontend/src/components/board/LiveData.tsx` — Live-data status and controls.
- `app/frontend/src/components/board/BarChart.tsx` — Bar chart rendering.
- `app/frontend/src/components/board/BoardView.tsx` — Board presentation and analysis.
- `app/frontend/src/lib/aiBuild.ts` — AI gateway requests and generated-board handling.
- `app/frontend/src/lib/liveData.ts` — Client-side live model-data logic.
- `app/frontend/src/lib/board.ts` — Board data and client-side helpers.
- `app/frontend/src/lib/i18n.tsx` — English and Chinese translations.
- `app/frontend/src/components/board/` — Leaderboard layout, charts, model table, and methodology components.
- `app/frontend/src/components/blog/` — Blog article presentation and markdown rendering.
- `app/frontend/src/components/ui/` — Reusable interface primitives.
- `app/frontend/prerender/` — Blog route, page, and sitemap prerendering.
- `app/frontend/plugins/` — React HMR and web SDK entity-update guards with tests.
- `app/frontend/package.json`, `vite.config.ts`, `tailwind.config.ts` — Frontend scripts, build tooling, and styling configuration.
- `app/start_app_v2.sh` — Application startup helper.

# Technology Stack
- **Frontend:** React, TypeScript, Vite, and Tailwind CSS.
- **Backend:** Python, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, and Alembic.
- **Charts:** Inline SVG charts implemented in the frontend.
- **Cloud and data:** Atoms Cloud database and supporting SDK/API integrations.
- **AI and model data:** LLM gateway for AI board creation; server-side integrations with Artificial Analysis and OpenRouter for model data.
- **Quality:** ESLint, Playwright configuration, and plugin tests.

# Usage
- Install backend dependencies from `app/backend` with `pip install -r requirements.txt`.
- Install frontend dependencies from `app/frontend` with `npm install`.
- Run frontend linting from `app/frontend` with `npm run lint`.
- Start the frontend development server from `app/frontend` with `npm run dev`.
- Create a frontend production build with `npm run build`.
- Run the backend using `app/start_app_v2.sh`, or start it from `app/backend` with the configured ASGI server.
- Apply database migrations from `app/backend` with `alembic upgrade head`.
- Configure the required Atoms Cloud and database settings before running the application. Set the server-side `AA_API_KEY` to enable Artificial Analysis; without it, model data uses OpenRouter, with Artificial Analysis also falling back to OpenRouter if its request fails.
